{{Top|leg}}
A '''Jedi lorebook''' was found by [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement]] [[Detective/Legends|detective]] [[Solimon Dambrizi]] during a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] raid on [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. Although in poor condition, Dambrizi held on to the tome and learned that his "sixth sense" insight was a manifestation of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="WHSV">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
